pr_title: Add tooltips with precise dates to beatmap set overlay
pr_body:
Closes #7777 

Field constructor is intentionally duplicated because the old one becomes obsolete as soon as #7540 is merged.
pr_comments: I used [`RankGraphTooltip`](https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/804d210250a7b2b430da59fab7f55a6e2cd40394/osu.Game/Overlays/Profile/Header/Components/RankGraph.cs#L218) for reference. Not sure if the colors are right, but they will eventually be supplied by `OverlayColourProvider` anyway.

issue_context.title: Dates inside BeatmapSetContainer don't have tooltip
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:** All dates inside the `BeatmapSetContainer` don't have a tooltip that should show their "long version" like in the web version.

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 
|  | Lazer  | Web |
| -------- | ------------- | ------------- |
| submission/rank status date | ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43073074/74103792-678cc600-4b4f-11ea-9809-11aeedbc3605.png) | ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43073074/74103788-58a61380-4b4f-11ea-87ab-01caceaf67ff.png) |
| score date | ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43073074/74103802-7a9f9600-4b4f-11ea-816a-8bf3240ff175.png) | ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43073074/74103814-8ee39300-4b4f-11ea-8a96-266be9ba2c35.png) |

**osu!lazer version:** 2020.208.0

review_comments: This is not consistent with web - dropping the `ToString()` means that the date will get automatically humanised. See screenshots in the original issue for how the date should look like.

Wouldn't it make more sense to instead change web to the humanised form to be consistent with all other occurrences of time stamps?
![Capture](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/32681550/74111396-94af9780-4b94-11ea-8f15-bec9691d4c87.PNG)
![Capture2](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/32681550/74111400-95e0c480-4b94-11ea-89e7-0eba386c1cf2.PNG)
![Capture3](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/32681550/74111401-95e0c480-4b94-11ea-8064-4f4ae5831253.PNG)
![Capture4](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/32681550/74111403-95e0c480-4b94-11ea-98c6-d48954fd6246.PNG)

I imagine this might have been an intentional choice. Note that humanised dates are used in lists of things, where it's more readable to have a human-readable offset rather than a precise date. In the case of beatmap metadata, however, IMO it is more useful to see the full date outright without having to hover over it or trying to do mental math. I am however not sure.

cc @arflyte - could you confirm/deny if this was intentional? We're talking about the date format in beatmap metadata display, as depicted here:

![](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43073074/74103788-58a61380-4b4f-11ea-87ab-01caceaf67ff.png)
It should be matching, so short date format is best here.
actually let's go with relative for now. it feels better.
Also not consistent with the web date format.
The appearance of these elements doesn't match web design.
I'm not quite sure what's wrong here. Can you elaborate?

OK, I kind of highlighted the wrong place, but what I meant to point out is the difference in tooltip typography - web tooltip has date in white, bold font, time + offset in regular, slightly dimmed colour, while lazer-side it's all regular white text.
This would require a framework change for how tooltips work which is beyond the scope of this PR.

I don't think that's correct. Custom tooltips are already supported - check the `IHasCustomTooltip` interface and its lazer-side implementations.

Now changing `DrawableDate` to use it *might* warrant a separate PR, but I'm not overly convinced it does.
You're right. I switched to `IHasCustomTooltip` now.
